The portable release includes the unmodified smartctl.exe installed from smartmontools 7.5.
Corresponding upstream source is included as smartmontools-7.5-source.tar.gz.
Source: https://github.com/smartmontools/smartmontools
Tag: RELEASE_7_5
Tag commit: f276b249fdc84019403491303479485030ac7c80
Downloaded archive: https://codeload.github.com/smartmontools/smartmontools/tar.gz/refs/tags/RELEASE_7_5

The application invokes smartctl as a separate subprocess through its JSON command interface.
